title: Minha Casa Minha Vida Financing Simulator
description: Estimate income band, nominal rate, financed amount, and SAC or Price payments for Minha Casa Minha Vida using rules checked in 2026.
metaTitle: Minha Casa Minha Vida Financing Simulator | SAC and Price
metaDescription: Estimate Minha Casa Minha Vida income band, nominal rate, financed amount, and payments. Rules checked on 2026-07-03; no official subsidy or approval calculation.

source.title: Sources and version
source.text: Public rules checked on {accessDate}. The simulation uses nominal annual rate divided by 12 and does not reproduce a bank contract.

items.estimativaEducativa: Educational estimate only; not an official quote, credit approval, benefit entitlement, or purchase recommendation.
items.fonteVersionada: Income, rate, subsidy, and property-cap rules may change after version 2026-07-03.
items.subsidioNaoCalculado: The subsidy/discount is not calculated automatically; use only a value from an official simulator or quote.
items.creditoBancarioNecessario: The household still needs credit analysis and approval by an enabled financial institution.
items.cetNaoIncluido: Brazilian CET, insurance, fees, ITBI, registration, notary costs, dates, and contract rounding are not included.
items.taxaManual: Manual rate used; check whether it is nominal annual and whether the quote uses the same convention.
items.taxaOficialIndisponivel: No official rate is selected for this scenario; enter a manual rate to simulate payments.
items.foraMcmv: Income above R$13,000.00 is outside the consulted urban MCMV scope.
items.limiteMunicipalNecessario: For Faixas 1 and 2, the exact cap depends on the municipality; this calculator uses only the published national range.
items.imovelAcimaLimite: The property value exceeds the source-rule cap or the local cap you entered.

items.prazoAcima360: Term above 360 months is allowed up to 420 months in the source rule, but is more sensitive to interest.
items.cotaUsadoClasseMedia: For Classe Media and used property in South/Southeast/Center-West, check the financing quota if LTV exceeds 60%.

howToUse.title: How to use the Minha Casa Minha Vida simulator
howToUse.p1: Enter household income, region, FGTS account-holder status, property value, down payment, FGTS used as down payment, informed subsidy, term, and SAC or Price.
howToUse.p2: The calculator estimates band, source-table nominal rate, financed amount, payments, and interest. Treat it as screening before the official bank simulator.

incomeBands.title: Minha Casa Minha Vida income bands in 2026
incomeBands.p1: Version 2026-07-03 classifies urban monthly income as Faixa 1 up to R$3,200, Faixa 2 up to R$5,000, Faixa 3 up to R$9,600, and Classe Media up to R$13,000.
incomeBands.p2: Income above R$13,000 appears as outside MCMV in this tool and receives no automatic official rate.

ratesAndMethods.title: Nominal rates, SAC, and Price
ratesAndMethods.p1: The source table publishes nominal annual rates. To simulate payments, the tool divides the rate by 12 and also shows the equivalent annual effective rate.
ratesAndMethods.p2: SAC creates constant principal amortization and decreasing payments. Price creates a nearly constant payment under a fixed-rate assumption.

subsidy.title: Subsidy/discount: why it is not automatic
subsidy.p1: The public page gives caps and general factors, but does not publish a complete formula for each household's individual subsidy.
subsidy.p2: Therefore, the subsidy field should contain only a value from an official simulator, bank quote, or institution guidance.

propertyLimits.title: Property value caps and municipality checks
propertyLimits.p1: For Faixas 1 and 2, the source page uses a national range from R$210,000 to R$275,000, but the effective cap can depend on the municipality.
propertyLimits.p2: Faixa 3 uses a R$400,000 national cap and Classe Media uses R$600,000 in the consulted version.

bankDifferences.title: Why Caixa or bank quotes can differ
bankDifferences.p1: Real contracts can include CET, insurance, fees, registration, ITBI, due dates, rounding, indexation, and credit analysis.
bankDifferences.p2: A favorable result does not guarantee approval, rate, subsidy, property cap, or final schedule.

officialLinks.title: Official sources
officialLinks.intro: Version 2026-07-03 uses public Ministry of Cities pages as the source for rules and limitations.

disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.text: Educational estimate only. It does not provide credit, legal, tax, banking, real-estate, or public-benefit advice; it does not calculate official subsidy, approval, CET, insurance, registration, or final contract values.

q1.question: Who can finance through Minha Casa Minha Vida?
q1.answer: Households within the income bands and property rules can seek financing through an enabled institution, but still depend on credit analysis and official criteria.

q2.question: Which income goes into each band?
q2.answer: In this version: Faixa 1 up to R$3,200, Faixa 2 up to R$5,000, Faixa 3 up to R$9,600, and Classe Media up to R$13,000 of monthly gross urban household income.

q3.question: Does the simulator calculate the official subsidy?
q3.answer: No. The subsidy field is entered by you and should come from an official simulator, bank, or quote. The tool only subtracts that value from the financed balance.

q4.question: Which interest rate should I use?
q4.answer: With official mode on, the nominal annual rate comes from the source table checked on 2026-07-03. For a specific quote, turn it off and enter the manual rate.

q5.question: What is the maximum term?
q5.answer: The source rule allows up to 420 months. The calculator accepts that limit and warns when the term is above 360 months.

q6.question: SAC or Price: which payment looks lower?
q6.answer: Price tends to show a lower, constant initial payment. SAC usually starts higher, but reduces the payment and often lowers total interest.

q7.question: Does the result guarantee approval?
q7.answer: No. Approval, accepted income, subsidy, rate, property cap, and final schedule depend on Caixa, Banco do Brasil, or another enabled institution.

q8.question: Can I use FGTS as down payment?
q8.answer: The source page allows FGTS use as down payment under program rules. The simulator treats the entered value as a reduction of the financed balance.
